units.source_text: 如果你有心悔改，主動找我商量，我會好好幫你想想辦法的。」

en.t: If you are truly willing to repent and come to me of your own accord to discuss it, I will do my best to think of a way to help you."

units.source_text: 比目魚說話的方式，不，應該是世上所有人的說話方式，都如此的煩瑣與含糊，有一種微妙的想逃避責任的複雜性。

en.t: The way Flounder spoke, no, the way everyone in the world spoke, was always so convoluted and vague, with a subtle complexity that seemed meant to evade responsibility.

units.source_text: 對於他們近乎徒勞的防範心理，以及數不勝數的小小心計，我總是感到困惑，

en.t: I was always bewildered by their almost futile defensiveness and their countless petty little schemes,

units.source_text: 最終以怎麼都行的心態，要麼用搞笑敷衍，要麼默默首肯一切，也就是採取所謂敗北者的態度。

en.t: until in the end I would fall into a mood of not caring either way, either brushing it off with jokes or silently nodding along to everything, taking what might be called the attitude of a defeated man.

units.source_text: 多年後我才知道，如果當時的比目魚能簡單扼要地告訴我，

en.t: Only many years later did I realize that if Flounder had simply and plainly told me what mattered at the time,
things might have turned out differently.
